subject: Stipend reallocation & post-pilot invoice offset request - Flux Systems
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: trialops@fluxsystems.com, finance@fluxsystems.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stipend reallocation & post-pilot invoice offset request - Flux Systems

Hi Maya / Flux team,

Thanks again for running the May pilot with us. The usage report attached shows Flux consumed 3.1M tokens of the 4M pilot stipend; that leaves an unused balance of $12,500 (see usage_report_flux_may2028.csv). Flux also has Invoice #FS-2047 outstanding for May consumption (~$18,900).

Request: with your approval we'd like to reallocate the $12,500 unused stipend as a credit memo applied to FS-2047 (invoice offset) rather than issuing a refund. This keeps bookkeeping simple for both sides and avoids a cash transfer. If you prefer, we can instead post the credit as a promo allowance (contra-revenue) — please let us know.

Next steps we need from you:
- Confirm you approve application of a $12,500 credit to FS-2047 (or indicate preference for a refund).
- If offset is OK, confirm the billing contact/PO or ERP reference you want us to include on the credit memo.
- If you'd like a trial extension instead of crediting the invoice, tell us the desired extension window and whether you want a top-up stipend.

I've attached the pilot agreement and the raw usage extract for your review. I'll loop in our billing team to prepare the formal credit memo and the suggested ledger mapping.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if that's easier.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162

Attachments: pilot_agreement_flux.pdf (agreement stub), usage_report_flux_may2028.csv (CSV summary)

From: Maya Patel <finance@fluxsystems.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stipend reallocation & post-pilot invoice offset request - Flux Systems

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the details. Quick questions from our finance team:
1) Can you confirm the exact credit amount you propose ($12,500) and whether the credit should reduce FS-2047 or be held as a pre-paid balance against future invoices?
2) We need a short justification line on the credit memo for our AP team (e.g., "unused pilot stipend - promotional credit").
3) Please confirm whether Redwood classifies this as a contra-revenue credit or an allowance so our GL mapping is consistent.

If you can send a draft credit memo and the suggested journal entry, we should be able to approve on our side quickly.

— Maya
Maya Patel
Director of Finance | Flux Systems
finance@fluxsystems.com

Thanks Maya — looping in Karthik and Laura from Billing/Finance to confirm treatment.

Quick answers:
- Proposed credit: $12,500 applied to FS-2047 (we prefer to clear the current outstanding invoice).
- Justification line we suggest: "Unused pilot stipend - promotional credit (May 2028)."
- I believe Redwood posts these as promotional allowances (contra-revenue), but Karthik will confirm exact ledger/GL mapping and provide the journal entry template.

Attached: calculated_credit_breakdown.xlsx (breakdown by date and unused token bucket).

Karthik / Laura — can you confirm: a) account code we should use; b) whether we route this through the promo allowance workflow or as a direct credit memo; c) any ERP ticket/PO details to include on the memo.

If we get confirmation today, I'll generate a draft credit memo and send to Flux for sign-off.

Jordan

Attachments: calculated_credit_breakdown.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <finance@fluxsystems.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stipend reallocation & post-pilot invoice offset request - Flux Systems

Jordan / Maya — thanks for pulling this together. From an accounting perspective we recommend posting the credit memo as a promotional allowance (contra-revenue) to keep revenue recognition clean. Proposed booking:
- Debit: Promotional Allowances (GL 5400) $12,500
- Credit: Accounts Receivable (Customer Credit) $12,500

Narrative line: "Unused pilot stipend - promotional credit (May 2028)". That will match Flux's AP expectations.

Action items for billing ops: Laura, please create the credit memo for FS-2047 using the attached journal_entry_template.csv and route it to ERP ticket ERP-4391 for posting. Flux, if you can confirm the PO/ERP reference you'd like on the memo we'll include it in the description.

I'll also note on our side this is not a cash refund but an invoice offset; if Flux later requests a refund we can process that via AR workflows.

Karthik
Head of Finance (acting) | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: journal_entry_template.csv

Jordan / Karthik / Laura — Flux approves the proposed treatment. Please:

3) Include PO# FLX-9921 on the credit memo.

Once we receive the signed credit memo PDF we will close FS-2047 on our AP side. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

— Maya
